metadata.name: IsaacFPS
metadata.description:
IsaacFPS - FPS booster and performance toolkit for big mod collections.
Reduces stutter and wasted work when many mods are loaded: - GC tuning (fewer garbage-collection hitches from heavy Lua mods) - Sound spam dedupe (SFXManager():Play wrapper) - Debug log spam filter (Isaac.DebugString rate limiting) - Overlay freezing while paused - Throttled render/update callback library with automatic detail scaling - Shared Font cache and per-frame memoization cache - Built-in diagnostics: FPS overlay, fpsbench() benchmark, frame spike report
Type fpshelp() in the debug console for all commands. Works standalone, requires no other mods. Designed for Repentance.
